overall_explanation:
Partition 7 Source/native-consumer decisions:
• skills/common/plugin-runtime/foundation/observability/durable-attempts.ts — PASS: selected bytes are opaque attempt-evidence artifacts, copied from managed evidence into content-addressed blobs; result storage and completeness consumers verify size/digest. This does not qualify arbitrary evidence contents as diagnostic text.
• scripts/check-operator-task-registry.mjs — PASS: selected output contains fixed explanatory text and validated collection counts; failures throw assertions rather than publish registry objects.
• scripts/vendor-external-helm-authorities.mjs — PASS: selected console output reports counts after offline archive extraction and artifact comparison. Refresh separately downloads digest-checked archives and writes authority artifacts; those effects are not justified by the diagnostic receipt.
• scripts/check-configuration-cli-drift.mjs — PASS: selected stdout/stderr forward the failed configuration-inventory checker’s diagnostic streams, including its Python/external-Helm failure diagnostics. Successful structured inventory publications use separate paths.
• skills/common/plugin-runtime/foundation/config/published-pair.ts — PASS: retained api-capable-utility classification is appropriate. The selected writer publishes immutable JSON members and materialized copies under a digest manifest; the selected progress/pipeline caller constructs native scaffold configuration, subsequently read by scaffold discovery and pipeline scope/lint loaders.
• scripts/check-monitoring.mjs — PASS: selected bytes come from the rendered Alloy ConfigMap’s config.alloy entry and feed the Alloy validator through a temporary mounted file. They are native configuration, not a diagnostic waiver for the surrounding Kubernetes documents. Render-directory, Helm/chart, and Docker-image inputs remain external dependencies.
• scripts/retire-attempt-result.mjs — PASS: stdout contains operation identity and retirement counters from the fenced retained-run/store operation; failures emit a bounded code object. Mutable journals, snapshots and stores remain authorization inputs.
• skills/prism/server/agent-bridge.mjs — PASS: selected emissions are runner/shutdown exception diagnostics. Control response text can occur inside exceptions; HTTP response forwarding remains a separate publication path.
• skills/prism/server/native-worker-host.ts — PASS: bounded, validated stdin produces worker-attempt protocol JSON; the supervisor parses, checks binding and reseals the result. Hydrated artifact input and artifact uploads remain separate network inputs/effects.
Scope: only listed factsDigest refreshes and their selected native consumer closures. No registry-wide, gate, requirements, communication-checker or host-lifecycle acceptance; no producers, tests, cluster operations or live checks executed. These decisions establish output purpose, not runtime input/byte/effect qualification.
